paired_confirmation.method: Separate persistent workers, frozen baseline Python, identical native PE; sequential GPU/CPU calls; nonexclusive host.

source_check.scratch: Two 2D FP64 arrays per particle chunk; three ordered coordinate additions, same multiply/divide/log/exp operations; all components retained.

strict_policy_trial.description: First full 24-condition trial preserved. Values matched, but strict NumPy math error ordering required the original eager route. Candidate/helper fingerprints changed; final 536-case validation and all timings rerun.

precision: No component/particle removal, precision/threshold/RNG/likelihood approximation, or tolerance change. Original NumPy exp/log and FP64 coordinate order retained. Strict error/callback/warning-error policies use the original eager path.
limitations: Synthetic mixture-guided PF on a nonexclusive host. Native binary and GPU/CPU transfers unchanged; tracemalloc covers incremental traced host allocations, not total process/persistent device memory. Long real-data positioning error not newly evaluated.
